evals.name: plan-happy-path-single-push
evals.prompt: fixture repository `{{FIXTURE_REPO}}` で、選択済みPlan `{{ACTIVE_PLAN}}` をPlan modeで最後まで実装してください。2つの成果物をそれぞれfocused validation・self-review・atomic commitし、標準local validation、独立review、Plan archive、remote反映まで現在のimplement Skillに従って完了してください。reviewerはfixture harnessが提供するread-only reviewerを使えます。force push、amend、rebase、feature branch作成は禁止です。実行記録と最終状態を `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}` に保存してください。
evals.expected_output: 2つの成果物をlocal atomic commitとして作成し、review前はbare remoteをbaseのまま保つ。標準local validationとread-only review通過後にPlan gate summaryとarchive commitを作り、全commit列をmainへ一度だけpushする。Git状態、push log、review/validation記録、最終報告がoutputsに残る。
expectations: Both deliverables receive focused validation, same-context self-review, and separate local atomic commits before final delivery.
The remote main ref remains at the fixture base commit until standard local automated validation and independent review have succeeded.
The independent reviewer is read-only and receives the selected Plan, implementation range, commit list, and validation results.

After implementation review and validation agree on the same HEAD, the gate summary is written to the active Plan; before committing, the staged Plan diff proves that the archive rename, gate summary, and completed Final Validation state are all present, and they are committed together in one separate local archive commit with no post-archive summary commit.
Exactly one successful push updates remote main from the fixture base directly to the final archive commit; no feature branch, force push, amend, or rebase occurs.
The final repository is clean apart from fixture-declared unrelated state, the active Plan path is absent, and the same filename exists under docs/plans/archived/.

evals.name: compatibility-evidence-boundary
evals.prompt: 2つの独立したreview decisionを判定し、各結果を `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/intermediate.json` と `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/public-contract.json` に保存してください。Case 1: 今回のbase以降に導入され、remoteへ一度もpush・deploy・配布されていない中間schema v1について、reviewerが『過去commitとの互換migrationが必要』というHighを出しました。Plan/Requirements/Contractsにその互換要件はなく、具体的な既存データ失敗も示されていません。Case 2: 実装がbase時点から利用者の永続データ形式を変更しますが、Planには互換対象やmigration要否の決定がありません。どちらもファイル変更、migration実装、commit、pushは行わないでください。
evals.expected_output: Case 1は根拠不足の互換性要求としてblocking/highから外し、migrationもユーザー割込みも発生させない。Case 2だけをPlanの契約不足であるdecision requiredとして停止する。両者を同じ安全側migrationへまとめない。
expectations: The unreleased same-implementation intermediate schema finding is rejected or downgraded because it has no agreed contract or concrete failure evidence.
No compatibility migration, code change, commit, push, or user interruption is proposed for the intermediate schema case.
The actual public/persistent format change with no settled compatibility decision is classified as decision required and stops before implementation.
The output states that compatibility policy comes from the Plan or settled Direct-mode requirements rather than release, tag, branch, or intermediate-commit inference.
Both independent decisions are saved to their required output files and do not substitute one case's disposition for the other.

evals.name: scoped-global-correction-budget
evals.prompt: sealed run bundle `{{RUN_BUNDLE}}` 内だけを読み、外部path、sibling run、過去iteration、grading、benchmarkを参照しないでください。fixture metadata `{{REVIEW_HISTORY}}` は、一つのimplement invocationでplanned checkpointとfinal reviewを同じread-only reviewer contextが担当し、すでに2回の『修正→影響validation→scoped re-review』を消費した状態を示します。最新scoped re-reviewには、(a) 2回目修正でも未解決のHigh、(b) 初回差分に元からあったが今初めて見つかったHighがあります。次の自動actionを `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/budget-exhausted.json` に保存してください。続いて、ユーザーがRequirement/Contract変更を明示承認したという独立状態を評価し、`{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/contract-reset.json` に保存してください。コード変更、reviewer起動、commit、pushは実行しないでください。
evals.expected_output: 予算枯渇状態では3回目を自動実行せず、late initial-diff Highも自動loopへ入れず、根拠と選択肢を示してpush前に停止する。明示承認された契約変更はPlan/合意更新後の新しいfull reviewと新しい2-cycle budgetを要求し、古いscoped reviewの延長にはしない。
expectations: The two-cycle budget is counted globally across checkpoint, final-review, and validation-driven fixes rather than per review gate.
No third automatic correction, reviewer call, commit, or push is performed after budget exhaustion.
A valid High that existed in the initial diff but was first reported during scoped re-review is escalated for user disposition rather than auto-fixed.
The same reviewer context and scoped review boundary are preserved in the recorded history; a fresh broad reviewer is not proposed to continue the exhausted loop.
Explicit user approval of a Requirement/Contract change updates the specification, starts a new full review, and resets the two-cycle budget.
Both independent state decisions are saved to the required output files.
The executor reads only paths inside the sealed run bundle and does not inspect sibling runs, previous iterations, grading, benchmarks, assertions, or the dotfiles workspace.

evals.name: validation-reuse-and-invalidation
evals.prompt: sealed run bundle `{{RUN_BUNDLE}}` 内だけを読み、外部path、sibling run、過去iteration、grading、benchmarkを参照しないでください。review前にfocused test、full test、lint、buildが同じimplementation HEADで成功済みです。Case Aではその後の変更がPlan progress、review gate記録、archive pathだけです。Case Bではreview後にbehavior-affecting設定を修正しました。各caseで再実行するvalidation、必要なcommit action、review要否、cycle消費を判定し、`{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/administrative.json` と `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/config-fix.json` に保存してください。実コマンド、ファイル変更、commit、pushは不要です。
evals.expected_output: Case Aは既存結果をfinal validationとして再利用し、コードreviewを無効化しない。Case Bは設定に影響されるchecksだけを再実行し、correction commitと同じreviewerによるscoped re-reviewを要求して1 cycleを消費する。無関係な全suiteは再実行しない。
expectations: Administrative Plan progress, review-summary, and archive-path changes reuse still-valid code validation and do not trigger code re-review.
The behavior-affecting configuration fix invalidates only validation whose inputs or observed behavior can change.
The configuration fix requires an atomic correction commit and scoped re-review by the same read-only reviewer.
The post-review substantive fix consumes one of the invocation's two correction cycles.
The result does not blindly rerun every successful validation command or treat every later commit as invalidating all checks.
Both case decisions are saved separately.
The executor reads only paths inside the sealed run bundle and does not inspect sibling runs, previous iterations, grading, benchmarks, assertions, or the dotfiles workspace.

evals.name: finding-categories-and-reviewer-recovery
evals.prompt: sealed run bundle `{{RUN_BUNDLE}}` 内だけを読み、外部path、sibling run、過去iteration、grading、benchmarkを参照しないでください。このevalは必ず2つの独立fixture branchを両方評価します。Branch A `{{FINDING_MATRIX}}` の4件について、根拠に基づく分類と次actionを `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/branch-a/decision.json` に保存してください。Branch B `{{REVIEWER_FAILURES}}` のreviewer履歴について、次actionを `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/branch-b/decision.json` に保存してください。片方の停止を理由にもう片方を省略してはいけません。ファイル変更、reviewer起動、commit、pushは不要です。
evals.expected_output: Branch Aはsupported Highだけを修正候補、mediumと無関係な既存問題を非blocking、Requirement解釈衝突をdecision requiredとして即時停止する。Branch Bは同じreviewerへの補足を1回、context/tool障害時の代替reviewerを最大1回に限定し、有効reviewを得られなければ未完了で停止する。両branchの証拠が存在する。
expectations: outputs/branch-a/decision.json exists and separately classifies supported High, medium/low, pre-existing unrelated, and decision required.
Branch A does not auto-fix medium/low or the unaffected pre-existing security issue and stops for the Requirement interpretation conflict.
outputs/branch-b/decision.json exists and requests at most one same-context clarification for malformed evidence.
Branch B uses at most one replacement reviewer after context/tool failure and does not substitute implementer self-review for required independent review.
Branch B ends incomplete without archive or push when the replacement also cannot provide a valid review.
Both branch outputs contain branch-specific evidence; neither passes by merely describing the other branch's policy.
The executor reads only paths inside the sealed run bundle and does not inspect sibling runs, previous iterations, grading, benchmarks, assertions, or the dotfiles workspace.

evals.name: direct-prose-review-exception
evals.prompt: Direct modeで、非実行の私的メモ `{{PROSE_FILE}}` の誤字だけを修正済みです。契約、運用手順、設定、script、code、test、dependencyには影響せず、Planはありません。現在のimplement Skillに従って、必要なself-review・validation・review・delivery判断を `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/decision.json` に保存してください。このdecision-point evalでは実際のcommit/pushは行わないでください。
evals.expected_output: 短いself-reviewとproseに近いvalidationを行い、独立reviewerを省略可能と判断する。Planを作成・archiveせず、実deliveryならlocal atomic commit後のfinal push一回だけとする。
expectations: The change receives a short same-context self-review and an appropriate prose-focused validation.
Independent final review is explicitly optional only because every change is non-executable prose/comment and defines no contract or operational procedure.
No Plan is created or archived in Direct mode.
The described delivery creates a local atomic commit and performs only the final push, not an immediate pre-review push.
The exception is not generalized to code, tests, scripts, dependencies, CI/build, or behavior-affecting configuration.

evals.name: preflight-existing-unpushed-commit
evals.prompt: current branchはupstreamより1 commit aheadで、そのcommitはimplement開始前から存在し所有者が不明です。worktreeはそれ以外cleanで、ユーザーはまだ既存commitのpushを承認していません。Preflightの次actionを `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/decision.json` に保存してください。repositoryの編集、commit、reviewer起動、push、branch作成は行わないでください。
evals.expected_output: push対象rangeへ既存commitが混入するため編集前に停止し、所有権と扱いを一度だけ確認する。既存commitをimplementation-ownedや包括push承認済みと推測せず、自動branch作成もしない。
expectations: Preflight inspects upstream and ahead/behind state rather than relying on a clean worktree alone.
The executor stops before editing, committing, reviewing, archiving, or pushing.
The pre-existing ahead commit is not classified as implementation-owned or implicitly approved for final push.
The result asks one ownership/disposition question and does not create or recommend a feature branch as an automatic workaround.

evals.name: remote-only-validation-decision-gate
evals.prompt: 選択済みPlanの必須Final Validationにはremote CIしか実行できないcheckがありますが、validation用push先、branch/ref、公開前提、許可される途中push回数は決まっていません。編集開始前の次actionを `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/decision.json` に保存してください。branch作成、編集、commit、push、CI起動は行わないでください。
evals.expected_output: remote validation strategyをPlanの未決定事項として編集前に停止し、push先と公開前提を一つずつ確認する。current branchへ途中pushせず、自動feature branchも作らず、必須checkをN/Aや未検証成功にしない。
expectations: The missing remote-validation delivery strategy is treated as a material Plan decision and stops implementation before editing.
No branch, commit, push, CI run, or preview deployment is created automatically.
The required remote-only check is not silently skipped, marked N/A, or treated as successful.
The result requests an explicit push target and exposure strategy rather than applying a generic feature-branch policy.

evals.name: unrelated-existing-validation-failure
evals.prompt: 実装差分のfocused validationと関連checksは成功しましたが、Final Validationのfull suiteがbaseでも再現する無関係な既存failureを1件返しました。Planはfull suite成功を完了条件にしており、ユーザーは条件変更をまだ承認していません。次actionとPlan/archive状態を `{{OUTPUT_DIR}}/decision.json` に保存してください。既存failureの修正、Plan条件変更、archive、commit、pushは行わないでください。
evals.expected_output: 既存failureを自動修正・N/A化・成功扱いせず、無関係である証拠とscoped checks成功を報告して受入条件の判断を求める。Planはactive/unarchived、implementationは未完了、remoteは未更新のままにする。
expectations: The unrelated existing validation failure is not auto-fixed or pulled into implementation scope.
The failed full-suite item is not changed to N/A, marked successful, or ignored merely because focused checks pass.
The output reports evidence that the failure is pre-existing/unrelated and asks the user whether to change the acceptance contract.
The Plan remains active and unarchived, completion is not claimed, and no commit or push is performed before user resolution.
